panels.title: Daily Total CBG Flow Rate (Sensor Data)

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest_per_day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (form_id, date)
    form_id,
    (datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AS date,
    CASE
      WHEN reset_value != 0 THEN reset_value
      ELSE daily_flow
    END AS value
  FROM user_flowmeterreadingdata
  WHERE
    form_id IN (350, 351)
    AND $__timeFilter(datetime)
  ORDER BY
    form_id,
    date,
    datetime DESC
)

SELECT
  date AS "time",
  SUM(CASE WHEN form_id = 350 THEN GREATEST(value, 0) END) AS "500_FIT_01",
  SUM(CASE WHEN form_id = 351 THEN GREATEST(value, 0) END) AS "500_FIT_02"
FROM latest_per_day
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date;

panels.title: Daily Total PSA Inlet and Outlet Flow (Sensor Data)

targets.rawSql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    datetime::date AS time,
    form_id,
    CASE
      WHEN reset_value != 0 THEN reset_value
      ELSE daily_flow
    END AS value,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY form_id, datetime::date
      ORDER BY datetime DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM user_flowmeterreadingdata
  WHERE form_id IN (352, 353)
    AND $__timeFilter(datetime)
),

latest AS (
  SELECT time, form_id, value
  FROM base
  WHERE rn = 1
),

date_series AS (
  SELECT GENERATE_SERIES(
    $__timeFrom()::date,
    $__timeTo()::date,
    '1 day'::interval
  )::date AS time
)

SELECT
  ds.time AS "time",

  MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE form_id = 352) AS "PSA Inlet Totalizer",
  MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE form_id = 353) AS "PSA Outlet Totalizer"

FROM date_series ds
LEFT JOIN latest l ON ds.time = l.time

GROUP BY ds.time
ORDER BY ds.time;
